disputes.title: Is the finale — and the VCIA exit — missable?

sides.claim: One-time only: the finale and the unscheduled VCIA departure cannot be repeated, so both trophies are missable.
Mission replay covers both: replay the finale and the VCIA mission and the trophies still pop.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved. Play the finale and the VCIA departure carefully the first time; if replay works, it is a safety net, not a plan.

disputes.title: How many stunts — and how many range challenges?

sides.claim: 250 stunts for Cunning Stunts and 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist.
A lower stunt total (200) and a narrower range set; the 42 counts practice rounds too.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved. This guide uses 250 and 42, the higher totals, so you cannot fall short.

disputes.title: Which nine activities count for Master of None?

sides.claim: Nine types: fishing, racing, drone racing, arcade, bowling, shooting range, meditation, hunting, stranger activity.
Arcade does not count as its own type; a different activity (golf or darts) is the ninth.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved. Try all ten candidates: the extra one costs minutes and covers both lists.

disputes.title: Card sets and WAiNK: how many, and where?

sides.claim: Three card sets with a fixed per-set count, and 100 WAiNK spots spread across Leonida.
Sets vary in size, and most WAiNK spots sit inside Vice City, not across the state.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved. This guide maps both: sweep Vice City first, then the wider state.

disputes.title: What counts as a choice — and as a challenge?

sides.claim: Any decision point counts toward the 500 choices, and daily/weekly challenges count toward the 50.
Only dialogue picks count as choices, and only open-world challenges count toward the 50.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved. Make every choice and clear every challenge type, so both readings fill.

disputes.title: Personal Best and The Truth Is Out There: what triggers them?

sides.claim: Personal Best is a partnership moment; The Truth Is Out There is a strange-event sighting.
Both triggers are different: a follower milestone and a specific location event.

disputes.verdict: Unresolved and both unconfirmed. Do not chase either until a second source verifies the trigger.

roadmap.title: First Playthrough — Story
roadmap.note: Play Chapters 1–4 and the finale in order. All twelve trophies here are story-locked; clear them as you go and mind the missable flags.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks
roadmap.note: Six stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus three more for the silver. Start strands early so their finals land before the story ends.

roadmap.title: Leonida Collectibles
roadmap.note: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK tags, vehicles, areas, garages and Scooter Bros. Use the GTABase maps and the counters tab.

roadmap.title: Combat & Challenges
roadmap.note: Stunts, the shooting range, challenges, Combat Focus, tanks, vaults, trucks, gangs, the VCIA exit and the silent jewelry job.

roadmap.title: Money & Activities
roadmap.note: Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, partner jobs, races, fishing, arcade, drone races, the nine activities and Bret's hunt.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & Platinum
roadmap.note: 100% completion, the platinum, bowling, the 500 choices — and the six unconfirmed trophies, which stay flagged until a second source verifies them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, clear the missables during the story, then mop up the counts. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both list it as automatic once the set is complete.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, introduces Lucia and Jason and ends the prologue. It cannot be skipped, so this is the first trophy most players earn. PowerPyx and Push Square both place it at the very start of Chapter 1.

steps.text: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen; no side objective is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finishing Chapter 1 means clearing its mission chain, including Gone Fishing and the missions that follow it. Push Square flags chapter trophies as story-locked: you cannot miss them, but you also cannot earn them early.

steps.text: Complete every mission in Chapter 1 in story order.
The trophy pops when the chapter-complete card appears.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's finale mission closes the chapter. Rockstar's own chapter structure is the source here, with PowerPyx and Push Square confirming the chapter-complete trigger.

steps.text: Complete every mission in Chapter 2 in story order.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete card after the finale mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 moves the story into Vice City proper. PowerPyx lists it as a straight chapter-complete trophy; Push Square notes the chapter's missions must all be finished, side content is not required.

steps.text: Complete every mission in Chapter 3 in story order.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete card after the finale mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale. PowerPyx and Push Square both confirm it pops on the chapter-complete card, with no collectible or side requirement attached.

steps.text: Complete every mission in Chapter 4 in story order.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete card after the finale mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission closes the story and awards this gold. Sources disagree on whether the finale is replayable for its trophy: Push Square treats the finale as a one-time story beat, while PowerPyx notes mission replay may cover it. See dispute D1. Either way, finish the finale and it pops.

steps.text: Play the final mission to its conclusion.
The gold pops at the mission-complete screen; see dispute D1 on replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 1 mission. PowerPyx and Push Square both list it as a mission-complete trophy with no extra objective: finish the mission and it pops.

steps.text: Play the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1.
Complete it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 2 set-piece. PowerPyx describes it as a story heist with a scripted escape; Push Square confirms the trophy is mission-complete only.

steps.text: Play the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 2.
Complete the heist and escape; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 2 mission. Both PowerPyx and Push Square list it as mission-complete only, with no fail state that locks the trophy.

steps.text: Play the mission Child's Play in Chapter 2.
Complete it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 3 mission. PowerPyx and Push Square agree it is a straight mission-complete trophy.

steps.text: Play the mission Headliners in Chapter 3.
Complete it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 3 mission at the airport. PowerPyx and Push Square list it as mission-complete only; do not confuse it with the free-roam VCIA trophy Catch Me If You Can.

steps.text: Play the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 3.
Complete it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 4 mission. PowerPyx and Push Square both confirm a mission-complete trigger with no extra objective.

steps.text: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4.
Complete it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the long tail of the platinum: every mission, stranger strand, collectible set, activity and count in this guide feeds it. PSNProfiles and Exophase both track it as the last gold most players earn, after the story. Work the roadmap in order and check the counters tab for what is left.

steps.text: Finish the story and every stranger strand first.
Complete all collectible sets: cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots.
Clear the activity and combat counts on the counters tab.
Finish the money and property counts, then check the stats screen.
Hit 100% on the stats screen; the gold pops immediately.
If it does not pop, re-check the counters tab for the one unfinished line.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts, tracked across free roam. PowerPyx counts 250 for the silver; EGamers notes stunts chain fastest on the Vice City highways and the airport runways. Sources disagree on whether the counter needs 250 or 200: see dispute D2.

steps.text: Use fast bikes and cars on highways to chain jumps and near-misses.
The airport runways give long, clean airtime for big stunt points.
Drift corners in Vice City to add stunt credit between jumps.
Watch the PSN counter on the counters tab; it climbs toward 250.
See dispute D2: some sources list a lower stunt total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types must each be tried once: the list itself is disputed. KeenGamer and EGamers disagree on which nine count, and whether an arcade game counts as its own type. See dispute D3. Try one of each: fishing, racing, drone racing, arcade, bowling, shooting range, meditation, hunting and a stranger activity.

steps.text: Try fishing once, with Cal, at any fishing spot.
Win or enter one race, one Top Fun drone race and one arcade game.
Bowl one frame, shoot one range challenge, meditate once, hunt once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges must be golded. Exophase confirms the 42 count; PSNProfiles tracks the same total. The dispute is over what counts as a challenge: see dispute D2. Gold thresholds are per-weapon, so practise each weapon class separately.

steps.text: Open the Shooting Range and work through the challenges weapon by weapon.
Learn each gold threshold before burning attempts on it.
Gold the pistol and rifle sets first; they teach the timing.
Clear the shotgun and heavy sets last, once your aim is warm.
Check the counter: 42 gold medals is the target.
See dispute D2 on what counts as a Shooting Range challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen Top Fun drone-race locations, one win at each. GamesFuze maps the locations across Leonida; Insider Gaming notes the races unlock as you discover them. Win, do not just finish: only a win ticks the location.

steps.text: Find the Top Fun drone-race spots; 14 in total across Leonida.
Learn each course's gates before racing it for the win.
Win at every location; a second place does not count.
Use the counters tab to see which locations are still missing.
Races in Vice City are the tightest; save them for last.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different races won: street, off-road and circuit all count, but the same race twice does not. GamesFuze and Insider Gaming both stress variety over repetition.

steps.text: Race across Leonida; each new race type adds to the total.
Win 20 different races; repeats of one race do not count.
Mix street circuits, off-road and highway sprints for variety.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival. Beat him in a fishing challenge: GamesFuze describes the challenge as a timed catch count, and Insider Gaming notes Cal appears at the fishing spots once you have fished a few times.

steps.text: Fish a few times at any spot until Cal offers a challenge.
Beat Cal's catch count inside the challenge timer.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. GamesFuze lists the arcade cabinets in Vice City; Insider Gaming notes any cabinet counts. Whether an arcade game also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None is disputed: see D3.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in Vice City and start a game.
Play it through to its end screen; quitting early does not count.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand ends with his final mission. KeenGamer maps the strand's missions; PSNProfiles confirms the trophy pops on the final one. Start the strand early so it is done before the finale.

steps.text: Find Andy and start his stranger strand.
Complete each of Andy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's stranger strand ends with his final mission. KeenGamer and PSNProfiles both place the strand's missions across the mid-story; the trophy pops on the final mission only.

steps.text: Find Kenton and start his stranger strand.
Complete each of Kenton's missions in order.
Finish his final mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's stranger strand ends with his final mission. KeenGamer maps the strand; PSNProfiles confirms the final-mission trigger.

steps.text: Find Billy and start his stranger strand.
Complete each of Billy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands completed across Leonida. KeenGamer lists the strands; PSNProfiles tracks the count at 8. The five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight; find three more strangers in free roam.

steps.text: Start every stranger strand you meet in free roam.
Finish the five named strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone.
Find and finish three more stranger strands anywhere in Leonida.
The silver pops on the eighth completed strand.
Check the counters tab: 8 strands is the target.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's stranger strand ends with his final mission. KeenGamer and PSNProfiles agree on the final-mission trigger.

steps.text: Find Randy and start his stranger strand.
Complete each of Randy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's stranger strand ends with his final mission. KeenGamer maps the strand; PSNProfiles confirms the trigger.

steps.text: Find Tyrone and start his stranger strand.
Complete each of Tyrone's missions in order.
Finish his final mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots across Leonida. GTABase maps all 18; Exophase confirms the count. Meditate at each one; the spots are quiet viewpoints, beaches and hilltops.

steps.text: Use the GTABase map to find all 18 meditation spots.
Meditate at each spot; the prompt appears when you stand in it.
Cover the beaches and the northern hills first; they hold the most.
Check the counter: 18 spots is the target.
The trophy pops at the eighteenth meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt one unique animal. GamesFuze describes the hunt as a tracked target, not a random animal; Insider Gaming notes Bret marks the hunting ground once you meet him.

steps.text: Meet Bret and take his hunting request.
Track the unique animal in the marked hunting ground and take it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three full collectible card sets. GTABase maps the card locations; Exophase confirms the three-set target. The dispute is over how many cards a set holds: GamesFuze and Insider Gaming give different per-set counts. See dispute D4.

steps.text: Find collectible cards across Leonida; GTABase maps them.
Complete one full set, then a second and a third.
Cards hide in shops, safehouses and story locations.
Check the counter: 3 complete sets is the target.
See dispute D4 on how many cards each set holds.
The silver pops on the third completed set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: the in-world photo/tag spots. GTABase maps them; Exophase confirms the 100 total. Whether all 100 sit inside Vice City or spread across Leonida is disputed: see dispute D4.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app at marked locations and tag them.
Work Vice City first; it holds the densest cluster.
Then sweep the coast towns and the northern routes.
Check the counter: 100 tagged locations is the target.
See dispute D4 on where the 100 locations sit.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Fifty challenges completed. PowerPyx lists the challenge types; EGamers notes daily and weekly challenges count alongside the open-world ones. What counts as a challenge is disputed: see dispute D5.

steps.text: Open the challenges menu and work the open-world list.
Mix driving, combat and exploration challenges for variety.
Daily and weekly challenges count toward the 50.
Check the counter: 50 completed challenges is the target.
See dispute D5 on which challenges count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. GamesFuze recommends building the wanted level away from the city centre, then breaking line of sight with your partner beside you. Your partner must be present when the stars clear.

steps.text: Bring your partner along before raising your wanted level.
Reach 4 stars, then break line of sight and escape with your partner.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. GamesFuze advises small shops in a row on one street; Insider Gaming notes losing the wanted level between robberies resets the chain.

steps.text: Bring your partner and pick three small shops on one street.
Rob the first, then the second and third without losing your wanted level.
Do not let the wanted level drop between robberies or the chain resets.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles: drive or enter each one and it counts. GTABase lists the vehicle roster; Exophase confirms the 100 total. Rare spawns cluster at the airport, the docks and the wealthy districts.

steps.text: Drive every new vehicle you see; entering it counts as discovered.
Sweep the airport, docks and wealthy districts for rare spawns.
Check the counter: 100 distinct vehicles is the target.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies inside one Combat Focus. PowerPyx describes Combat Focus as the slow-aim mode; EGamers recommends a crowded shootout so five targets are in range at once.

steps.text: Enter a shootout with at least five enemies in range.
Trigger Combat Focus and down five enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA (the airport) in an unscheduled way: take a plane and depart without a flight plan. Sources disagree on whether this is a one-time missable moment or replayable: Push Square calls it missable, PowerPyx says mission replay covers it. See dispute D1.

steps.text: Go to VCIA, take a plane and depart without following a flight plan.
See dispute D1: sources disagree on whether this can be repeated.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos are tanks. PowerPyx reads this trophy as surviving or dealing with Rhino tanks in free roam; EGamers notes the military base is where Rhinos spawn. Get in a Rhino or take one on and the trophy pops.

steps.text: Find Rhinos at the military base or during wanted-level chaos.
Get in a Rhino, or take one on, until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with no detection: no alarm, no witness, no camera spotting you. PowerPyx recommends going at night and cutting the cameras first; EGamers notes a silent approach through the back.

steps.text: Case a jewelry store and cut its cameras first.
Enter quietly at night and take the goods without tripping an alarm.
Leave without being seen; detection at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. PowerPyx maps the vault locations; EGamers stresses the escape: the robbery only counts once you are clear. Plan a fast car at each bank before you go in.

steps.text: Find the five bank vault locations across Leonida.
Stage a fast getaway car at each bank before entering.
Rob the vault, then escape cleanly; the count ticks on escape.
Repeat at all five banks.
Check the counter: 5 vaults robbed and escaped.
The silver pops after the fifth clean escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. PowerPyx notes the trucks run set routes through Vice City; EGamers recommends blocking the route, then breaking away fast once the cash is grabbed.

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route through Vice City.
Block it, grab the cash and escape before the escort responds.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. GTABase maps the 52 named areas; Exophase confirms the count. Drive through each one and the map fills in; the trophy pops on the last undiscovered area.

steps.text: Drive through every named area; the map marks each as found.
Sweep the coast towns first, then the inland routes.
Check the counter: 52 areas is the target.
The northern swamps and keys hide the last few areas.
The trophy pops when the fifty-second area is discovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs. PowerPyx lists the gangs and their turf; EGamers notes each operation is marked once you are near its territory. One per gang, nine in total.

steps.text: Learn the nine gangs and where each holds territory.
Rob one illegal operation in each gang's turf.
Operations are marked when you enter the gang's area.
Check the counter: 9 gangs is the target.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: Vice City Hustle reports a cocktail moment on Ocean Beach, but no second source has verified the trigger, the bar, or the exact requirement. Treat this as a rumour until PowerPyx, Push Square or Rockstar confirms it. Do not plan a run around it.

steps.text: Reported: have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED — one source only.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: GTABase lists a showroom-smash moment, but no second source has verified which showroom, what counts as classic style, or whether the trophy exists as described. Treat this as a rumour until a second source confirms it.

steps.text: Reported: smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. UNCONFIRMED — one source only.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through. GamesFuze places the alley in Vice City; Insider Gaming notes the follow-through is the scored part, not just showing up.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Bowl a full game and follow through on your shots.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: Vice City Hustle reports a partnership moment with mass appeal, but the trigger is unknown and no second source has verified it. GTABase lists a different trigger for the same name, which is why it sits in dispute D6. Treat this as a rumour.

steps.text: Reported: a partnership moment with mass appeal. UNCONFIRMED — see dispute D6.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Five hundred choices, tracked by PSN. PSNProfiles confirms the 500 count; Exophase tracks the same total. What counts as a choice is disputed: some sources count dialogue picks, others count any decision point. See dispute D5.

steps.text: Make choices whenever the game offers them: dialogue, jobs, side calls.
The PSN counter climbs toward 500 across the whole playthrough.
See dispute D5 on what counts as a choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: GTABase reports a second-try success trophy, but no second source has verified what must be failed once and then passed, or whether the trophy exists as described. Treat this as a rumour until a second source confirms it.

steps.text: Reported: succeed on a second try. UNCONFIRMED — one source only.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: Vice City Hustle reports a strange-event trophy, but the event, the place and the trigger are all unverified, and GTABase gives a different account of the same name. See dispute D6. Treat this as a rumour.

steps.text: Reported: witness something strange. UNCONFIRMED — see dispute D6.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: GTABase reports a melee drive-by knockdown, but no second source has verified the move, the target, or the count. Treat this as a rumour until a second source confirms it.

steps.text: Reported: knock someone down with a melee drive-by. UNCONFIRMED — one source only.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. GamesFuze explains the laundering loop: Marked Bills come from heists and robberies, and contacts clean them for a cut. Insider Gaming notes the cut varies by contact, so use the cheapest contact for the full $250,000.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from heists, vaults and truck robberies.
Take them to a contact to launder; each contact takes a cut.
Use the cheapest contact to keep more of the $250,000.
Check the counter: $250,000 laundered is the target.
The trophy pops when the laundered total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops: clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything. GamesFuze notes the total is cumulative across every shop type; Insider Gaming recommends buying the big-ticket items (cars, weapons) to reach it fast.

steps.text: Spend across all shop types; the total is cumulative.
Big-ticket buys (cars, weapons) move the total fastest.
Check the counter: $100,000 spent is the target.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties. GTABase maps the eight garages; Exophase confirms the count. They unlock across the story, so buy each one as it appears rather than saving them all for the end.

steps.text: Buy each garage property as it becomes available.
Eight garages in total across Leonida.
Check the counter: 8 garages is the target.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. GTABase lists the app's registration flow; Exophase confirms the ten-vehicle target. Any discovered vehicle can be registered, so pair this with Whip It Good.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a discovered vehicle.
Register ten different vehicles in total.
Pair this with Whip It Good: discover, then register.
